title: Family Law Attorneys in Clear Creek County

content.rendered:
Family Law Attorneys in Clear Creek County

Get the help you need!

Call (303) 261-8111

Your divorce, your custody arrangement, your financial future — when all of it is in motion at once, the attorney you hire needs to know where your case will actually be heard.

The Drake Law Firm serves Clear Creek County clients from our Golden office, which is the closest established family law office to Idaho Springs and Georgetown. We handle the full range of family law matters for Clear Creek County residents and anyone whose case is filed here. We start every case looking for the most efficient path to resolution. When that path is available, we take it. When it isn’t, we go to a hearing prepared.

Schedule a Consultation

Call for immediate assistance: (303) 261-8111  |  Book online

What We Handle

We represent individuals and families throughout Clear Creek County in the following matters:

  • Divorce — contested and uncontested, including high-conflict and high-asset cases.
  • Child Custody (Parental Responsibilities) — parenting time, decision-making, and modification disputes.
  • Child Support — initial orders, modifications, and enforcement.
  • Spousal Maintenance — including temporary and long-term support disputes.
  • Property Division — real estate, retirement accounts, business interests, and debt.
  • Prenuptial and Postnuptial Agreements — drafting and review.
  • Paternity — establishing and challenging parental rights.
  • Modifications and Post-Decree — parenting plan changes, support modifications, and enforcement.

Our Offices and the Courts We Serve

Our Golden office is the nearest Drake Law Firm location to Clear Creek County. We do not have an office in Clear Creek County, and we are straightforward about that. What we offer is a nearby team that files and appears in the Clear Creek County Combined Courts and understands how a smaller mountain-county court operates.

Communities and Areas We Serve

Clear Creek County — Primary Service Area

Idaho Springs, Georgetown, Silver Plume, Empire, Lawson, Dumont, Floyd Hill, Evergreen (Clear Creek County portion)

Adjacent Areas

Jefferson County, Park County. If you are unsure whether your case falls within our service area, call and ask.

Why Clear Creek County Families Choose The Drake Law Firm

We know this courthouse.

Our Golden office is the nearest established family law firm to Clear Creek County. You are not working with a downtown Denver firm that has never filed in Georgetown.

We know smaller-county logistics.

The Clear Creek County Combined Courts operate differently than a high-volume Front Range court. Smaller dockets, different administrative rhythms, fewer mediators to choose from. We know what to expect and how to prepare your case for the Clear Creek County system specifically.

No Drama is a real standard.

We push for efficient, cooperative resolution when it is available. When it isn’t, we go to hearing prepared and don’t blink. Both are true at the same time.

We tell you what you need to hear.

Not what you want to hear. Every case starts with an honest assessment of where you stand and what your realistic options are. We don’t run up the clock on false hope.

Results that reflect it.

Law Firm 500 ranked The Drake Law Firm #32 nationally in 2024 with 310% growth. Saturday appointments and Zoom consultations are available. We work with your schedule.

What to Expect When You Call

Reaching out to a family law firm is not a small thing. Here is what happens when you contact us:

  •  Your first call. Someone on our team will listen to your situation, answer your initial questions, and help determine whether your matter is the right fit for our practice.

  • Free 15-minute consultation. You will speak with an attorney about the specifics of your case, understand your options, and get a straight answer about what lies ahead.

  • A clear path forward. If we are the right fit, we will outline a strategy built around your goals and the realities of Clear Creek County’s court system.

Ready to talk? Schedule your consultation or call (303) 261-8111 for immediate assistance.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which courthouse will my family law case be filed in?

If you live in Clear Creek County, your case will be filed at the Clear Creek County Combined Courts at 405 Argentine St in Georgetown. That courthouse handles all district court family law matters for Clear Creek County residents, including divorce, parental responsibilities, and post-decree proceedings.

 

Do I need to come into an office, or can we meet virtually?

Both options are available. Our Lakewood office is on West Colfax, accessible from Denver in under 20 minutes from most central neighborhoods. Phone and Zoom consultations are also available, including Saturday appointments, for clients who prefer remote access or cannot take time off during the week.

Will my attorney appear in Clear Creek County courts?

Yes. If your case is filed in Clear Creek County, we represent you there. Our attorneys handle appearances at the Georgetown courthouse and are familiar with 5th Judicial District procedures.

What does it cost to hire The Drake Law Firm?

The Drake Law Firm operates on hourly billing. Costs depend on the complexity and duration of your matter. We discuss fees transparently during your consultation so there are no surprises.

I am not sure what kind of help I need yet. Can I still call?

Yes. That is exactly what the consultation is for. You don’t need to have everything figured out before you reach out. Call, describe your situation, and we will help you understand your options.

Start With a Conversation

Whatever your family is facing in Clear Creek County, the path forward starts with a single conversation. Schedule your free 15-minute consultation with The Drake Law Firm. We will listen, tell you the truth, and if we are the right fit, we will go to work.
